summary_1line: Rama and Ravana resume their fierce duel; Indra sends his chariot to aid Rama as divine weapons clash and Ravana unleashes a terrifying spear.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra’s golden chariot with bell-hung sides and radiant horses descends from the sky as Matali invites Rama to mount it amid the battlefield.
Ravana’s serpent-arrows transform into flaming snakes that swarm toward Rama, only to be destroyed by golden eagle-arrows from the Garuda weapon.
Ravana, ten-headed and furious, raises a blazing diamond-hard spear toward Rama while the earth and sky tremble at his roar.
